source: Seeded 2026-11-18 from week 11 by auto_overrides.py (out/lead_back/qb_start/ol_out carried; chances dropped). Re-verify against week 12 reports.

team_notes.BAL: Jacoby Brissett starts while Lamar (thumb, IR) and Huntley (toe) are out (Hensley via RotoBaller Nov 8; WagerTalk Nov 16). Feed still lists Huntley until Brissett's first game is played.
team_notes.MIN: Jordan Addison (thumb) out 'for the next few weeks' (Forbes Nov 16). Hockenson expected to progress for Sunday.
team_notes.KC: Kenneth Walker III (groin) DNP Monday after missing Wk10-11 (A to Z Sports Nov 23). Emmett Johnson lead back until Walker practices. Official status Wednesday for the Thursday game at BUF.
team_notes.DEN: Jonah Coleman the clear lead back after 58 of 75 snaps in Wk9 (Draft Sharks, Nov 9); Harvey and Badie on IR. Wk10 bye.
team_notes.CHI: RB Roschon Johnson (ankle) ruled out during Wk11 vs NO (NFL.com Nov 22).
team_notes.ARI: Josh Johnson started Wk11 (Beck back spasms, OUT; Minshew IR). SI starting-QB list (modified Nov 20): Arizona will start Josh Johnson in Week 12. Beck status for Wk12 pending.
team_notes.NYJ: Geno Smith (left ankle) avoided major injury in tests; Glenn: 'Geno's our starter', starts vs LAC if healthy (ESPN Nov 16; Yardbarker Nov 17). Klubnik if not. Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) tests.
team_notes.NYG: Skattebo had all 18 RB carries in the Wk10 TNF game (box score, Nov 12).
team_notes.HOU: Woody Marks (concussion) not expected to clear for TNF (Ryans). Montgomery (groin) full Fri/Mon practice, Ryans 'not certain' (Forbes Nov 16). Backfield left to the official report.
team_notes.LV: Brock Bowers (ankle) not believed major, day-to-day; more tests (Rapoport via Forbes Nov 16; Big Lead Nov 17). Mendoza starts.
team_notes.PIT: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, IR) practice window not open as of Nov 13; Post-Gazette: 'a little bit better feeling' for the Eagles game, more likely around Thanksgiving (Yardbarker Nov 13).
team_notes.IND: Daniel Jones released; Anthony Richardson named starter (Colts.com).
team_notes.DET: Aidan Hutchinson torn ACL, out for the season (Big Lead Nov 17).
team_notes.SEA: Darnold (quad) expected back from the bye as the starter vs SF (RotoBaller Nov 20; Seahawks 'optimistic' per FOX 13; Yahoo Nov 23 'a shot to get back'). Lock starts if not. Charbonnet lead back (36 of 68 carries Wk9-10).
team_notes.NE: Drake Maye fractured fibula, out at least six weeks (Yahoo Nov 23); Tommy DeVito starts (SI Nov 20). A.J. Brown (hamstring) likely out (Yahoo Nov 23).
team_notes.LAC: Justin Herbert in concussion protocol after the Wk11 loss to the Jets (NFL.com Nov 22). Status for Wk12 vs NE pending; still modeled as the starter.
team_notes.WAS: Croskey-Merritt (groin) played MNF Wk11: 13 of 20 RB carries (Ekeler 7, White 0; box score). Roster feed still lists him reserve, so he is listed under back. lead_back 0.50 kept (committee with Ekeler).
team_notes.LA: Puka Nacua MCL surgery, out months (CBS Nov 22). Kyren Williams (toe) limited Sunday.
team_notes.GB: Josh Jacobs (finger surgery Nov 13) 'unlikely to play in Week 12' (Yahoo Nov 23) and 'not expected to play' (Fantasy Alarm Nov 23); Kaleb Johnson the lead back. Re-check Wednesday's report before the 8 p.m. kickoff.
